ios.desc:
MoodWatch + transforms heart-rate patterns into a living HeartScape of color, light, and motion.

With your permission, Heart Connected compares recent Apple Health readings with your own recent baseline. It expresses what your heart rate is doing through neutral visual states such as Rising, Steady, Elevated, Lowering, and Below Baseline.

MoodWatch + never labels your emotions, infers your mood, or tells you how you feel.

HEARTSCAPE

• Watch heart-rate level and short-term movement take shape as fluid, responsive waves—or expressive emoji
• Move through nine visual states across a continuous spectrum of color
• See your current BPM, visual state, and sensor source at a glance
• Touch, drag, and pinch the HeartScape to create and save your own visual adjustment

CHOOSE HOW TO CONNECT

• Heart Connected can read up to 48 hours of recent Apple Health heart-rate samples and listen for new readings after you grant access
• Start a live check-in using AirPods Pro 3, a paired Apple Watch, or another compatible heart-rate source
• No wearable or Health permission? Use Self Report to choose a state yourself
• A guided introduction explains every route before you continue

CAPTURE A HEART RECORDING

Start a focused live check-in and watch a color-mapped trace form as each sample arrives.

• Review the session waveform, duration, average, minimum, maximum, and sample count
• MoodWatch + discards the temporary HealthKit workout instead of adding a fitness workout to your history
• When you choose to finish, name and save the Heart Recording in local app storage

HISTORY — UNLOCK ONCE, KEEP IT

• Revisit visual and self-reported state entries by day, week, or month
• Review saved Heart Recordings alongside your state timeline
• Unlock History with one non-consumable in-app purchase—never a recurring subscription
• Restore your purchase on devices using the same Apple Account

YOUR HEARTSCAPE, ACROSS YOUR APPLE DEVICES

Keep your latest HeartScape visible on iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, widgets, the Lock Screen, Live Activities, and Mac.

Through your private iCloud account, MoodWatch + can relay a small latest-state snapshot to the Mac companion—including BPM, visual state, source, time, session status, and visual style.

The Mac app does not access HealthKit and never receives your complete heart-rate history or saved Heart Recordings.

DESIGNED AROUND PRIVACY

Your heart-rate data should remain yours.

Goodnight sweet prince: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/moodwatch/id1663126370?uo=2

You were loved.

[Context] I made a biometric toy app to learn about watchOS and iOS. It uses the last 15 mins of heart rate data to assign an emotive state to the slope of the current reading in relation to the frame. It'll be incorporated soon enough. It was a fun learning experience.
